sources.note: Family-level only: p. 157 sec. 1.8 'In most of the ETHIOPIC languages Stress is not easily perceptible in the word. In GE'EZ, HARARI, and CHAHA the penultimate seems normally to be stressed.' JAOS reprint (p. ~228): 'The isolated forms and words have no stress in Ethiopic in general.' Selti (on which Leslau did fieldwork) is not singled out.
